product.name: Monoprice Heavy Duty Extension Cord - IEC 60320 C20 to IEC 60320 C21 12AWG 20A/2500W SJT 250V Black 6ft
product.description: This heavy‑duty IEC 60320 C20 to IEC 60320 C21 extension cord features 12 AWG conductors, making it suitable for high‑performance computers and network devices. It is a reliable solution for large server applications that require a higher‑rated, heavier‑gauge power cord. The C21 connector has two beveled corners and is rated to a higher temperature rating. The C22 male inlet is used primarily on Cisco® and Juniper® Networks equipment to a UPS system or PDU, or to replace or upgrade a standard power cord provided by the device's manufacturer.
